Little ivy-draped stone archways connect the cottages, their keystones carved with leaf-and-vine patterns, fairy-lanterns swaying gently beneath.
Arched footbridges with leaf-carved railings span the glittering streams, their mossy stones softened by years of elven tending.
Warm glowing leaded windows spill amber light onto the cobbles below, each pane set with tiny pressed wildflowers in the glass.
Flower-boxes overflow with lavender and moonbloom beneath every window, trailing vines nearly brushing the lantern-lit paths beneath them.
Hanging baskets of fern and heather dangle from iron hooks along the lanes, swaying with the sweet evening breeze.
Wisteria cascades in heavy violet curtains over the cottage eaves, its fragrance drifting through every open window at dusk.
Fairy-lanterns strung between rooftops glow soft gold and rose, their light dancing over the cobblestones like scattered embers.
Doorsteps are tucked with clusters of mushrooms in amber and cream, tiny toadstools crowning the mossy threshold stones like sentinels.
Spiral staircases of pale stone wind up the outside of the taller cottages, each step edged with trailing elfmoss.
Tiny balconies with wrought-iron railings hold potted herbs and trailing starflower, overlooking the winding lantern-lit lanes below.
Glowing vines climb the turret walls in slow spirals, their leaves faintly luminous, casting soft green light after dark.
Cobbled paths wind between the cottages in gentle curves, their stones worn smooth and edged with soft cushions of moss.
Little waterwheels turn slowly in the shallow village streams, their paddles carved with crescent moons and interlocking leaf shapes.
Mossy roofs slope at gentle angles, thick with green and gold, the whole village appearing to grow from the earth itself.
Chimneys of soft grey stone curl thin ribbons of sweet-smelling woodsmoke into the violet evening sky above the rooftops.
Wind-chimes of pale sea-glass and crystal hang at every eave, their soft ringing filling the lanes with gentle silver sound.
Garden gates of twisted willow-branch stand between cottage walls, their arches woven through with climbing roses and silver-leafed clover.
Stone wells at every lane-corner are ringed with ferns and wrapped in flowering ivy, their wooden covers carved with runes.
Tiny painted shutters in deep green and blue frame every window, each one carved with a different woodland creature or flower.
Communal herb gardens occupy every sunny corner, beds of rosemary, thyme, and elfroot bordered by hand-laid river pebbles.
Narrow lanes open suddenly into small circular plazas, each centered on a glowing stone fountain ringed with floating water-lilies.
Wooden signboards above the shop doors are painted with graceful elven script and small illustrations of leaves, stars, and animals.
Low stone walls border every garden, their tops softened with creeping thyme and studded with bright-capped toadstools after rain.
Roof gables are trimmed with finely carved wooden lacework, painted cream and green, depicting trailing vines and soaring birds.
Glowing moss fills the gaps between the cobblestones at night, the whole village paths shimmering with a soft bioluminescent blue.
